title: 第1156章 光阴长河第1155章 锐金
content_zh:
“嗯，这里应该便是光阴长河了吧”
头顶一柄银光小剑，一袭紫袍的老者行走在一片混沌河岸之上
在他的面前有着一条河流蜿蜒流淌看不到尽头
而有意思的是杨威在这些河水中看到了许多画面，那些熟悉又陌生的一幕幕正是许许多多平凡生灵的一生
从哇哇坠地到学会爬行走路乃至成家立业再拥有了自己的下一代周而复始，悲欢离合
杨威只是用看便度过了多少人的一生，这种感觉不由让他觉得新奇
而更让他心中微惊的是体内的百世书产生的反应似乎有一股时光之力正在与之连通
杨威当即俯下身子想取来一些水看看能不能直接被百世书吸收其中
结果他根本触碰不到这些水流，它们看起来像一条长河，可实际上并非是河，而是无数命运交织，有着人间的画面与未散的阴魂
所谓的光阴长河只不过是人们对它一种表现的描述
杨威万的苍茫茫一片的河流尽头不由感叹人生就是从那里开始的，随后又到这里结束
莫名的心中又升起一股悲苦之感
人生在世，苦难总是多于快乐
当然这也有可能他每次拿他的剧本都是穷哥们开局有关
此话或许也不全对，富人们也有富人的烦恼
正当杨威如此想着之时便寻到了河流中一段富家翁的生平
含着金汤匙出生，锦衣玉食荣华富贵，豪车豪宅，娇妻美妾奴仆丫鬟，应有尽有………
“狗日的有钱人！
看了一阵以后只道一句小时代曾不欺我
果然有钱还是爽的，他们的烦恼在穷人眼里那都不叫个事，下辈子做个富二代多好

杨威心中不由感叹
至于为何不是富一代？因为富一代还是要吃苦他只想一步到位
“继续走吧，一定有尽头的，路虽远，行则将至”
如此想着杨威不再多看朝着光阴长河的上流极速的飞跃
偶尔他还会碰到一些不长眼你的阴物，他们非是鬼怪却喜食人阳气
只是在此刻杨威的面前，他们根本造成不了任何的威胁
才刚冒头便立马被杨威头顶一柄小剑给斩了
事实上杨威也不知道，他头顶的这柄小剑究竟该叫什么？
似乎随着他不断地领悟剑意，这柄剑便会越来越大，此刻已有一柄水果刀大了通体散发着银白寒芒
便是这柄小剑成型了杨威这才从那般蒙昧的冥府边缘挣脱出来，直到此刻依旧有些恍惚，毕竟还没脱困前路迷茫也不知能否回到人间
这一次绝对是他数世以来最为离奇的遭遇，怎么也想不到鬼门关是这个样子，更想不到他还真走了一遭
“唰！
正想着又有一只不知死活的大型阴物阻挡在杨威面前照样砍瓜切菜般解决了
“不愧是老夫的剑论与地球意志融合，强大的化反恐怖如斯”
杨威不由点头称赞道
“老杨，老杨……
就在他前脚准备再走之时，忽而听到有人喊他回头一看却什么也没有
“我在这里，老杨，老杨……
的确有人在喊他而且就在附近还有些熟悉
杨威停下脚步四处张望开始仔细寻找声音来源

“老杨，老杨……
杨威终于看到了那是一缕极为细小的阴魂，它没有随着其他阴魂流淌而是停下来等待着自己
从外形看它就像是一块破抹布旁边还连接着一根线好似风筝一般连接着另一个小阴魂
“老杨，老杨，我在这里……
阴魂还在呼喊着，杨威蹲下身子小心将之捧在手心
content_en:
"Well, this should be the river of time, right?"
With a small silver sword above his head and an old man in purple robes, he walked on the bank of a chaotic river.
In front of him there was a river winding with no end in sight
What's interesting is that Yang Wei saw many scenes in these rivers. Those familiar and unfamiliar scenes were the lives of many ordinary creatures.
From falling to the ground to learning to crawl and walk and even starting a family and having your own next generation, the cycle of joys and sorrows begins again and again.
Yang Wei had lived through so many people's lives just by looking at them. This feeling made him feel novel.
What made him even more shocked was that the reaction produced by the Book of Worlds in his body seemed to be connected with the power of time.
Yang Wei immediately leaned down and wanted to get some water to see if it could be directly absorbed by the Book of Worlds.
As a result, he couldn't touch these currents at all. They looked like a long river, but in fact they were not rivers, but countless intertwined destinies, with scenes of the human world and lingering ghosts.
The so-called long river of time is just a description of its manifestations.
At the end of Yang Weiwan's vast river, he couldn't help but sigh that life begins there and then ends here.
An inexplicable feeling of sadness arose in my heart
In life, there is always more suffering than happiness
Of course, it’s also possible that every time he picks up his script, it’s because he starts with a poor guy.
This may not be entirely true. Rich people also have their own troubles.
Just when Yang Wei was thinking this, he found a section of the life of a rich man in the river.
Born with a silver spoon in his mouth, he has everything he wants, including fine clothes, fine food, luxury cars and mansions, a lovely wife, beautiful concubines, slaves and maids...
"What a rich man!
After watching it for a while, I just said: When I was a child, I never bullied me
Sure enough, it’s nice to be rich. Their worries are nothing in the eyes of the poor. It would be great to be a rich second generation in the next life.
Yang Wei couldn't help but sigh in his heart
As for why they are not the rich generation? Because the rich generation still has to endure hardships, he just wants to get there in one step
"Keep walking, there will be an end. Although the road is far, the journey will come soon."
Thinking of this, Yang Wei no longer looked at the rapid leap towards the upstream of the long river of time.
Occasionally, he will encounter some evil things that don’t have eyes for you. They are not ghosts but they like to eat human yang energy.
But in front of Yang Wei at this moment, they couldn't pose any threat at all.
As soon as he showed up, he was immediately beheaded by Yang Wei with a small sword above his head.
In fact, Yang Wei didn't know what the name of the small sword on his head should be.
It seems that as he continues to understand the meaning of the sword, the sword will become bigger and bigger. At this moment, it is as big as a fruit knife, and its whole body is exuding a silvery white cold light.
It was this small sword that took shape and Yang Wei broke free from the ignorant edge of the underworld. Up to this moment, he was still in a daze. After all, he had not yet escaped and was confused about the road ahead and did not know whether he could return to the human world.
This time is definitely the most bizarre encounter he has had in several lives. He never imagined that the gate of hell would be like this, let alone that he would actually go away.
"Ugh!
Just as he was thinking about another large evil creature blocking his way in front of Yang Wei, he still solved it like chopping melons and vegetables.
"As expected of me, my theory of swords merged with the will of the earth, so powerful that it can counteract terror."
Yang Wei couldn't help but nodded and praised.
"Lao Yang, Lao Yang...
Just as he was about to walk again, he suddenly heard someone calling. He turned around and saw nothing.
"I'm here, Lao Yang, Lao Yang...
Someone was indeed calling him, and he was nearby and seemed familiar.
Yang Wei stopped and looked around and began to carefully search for the source of the sound.
"Lao Yang, Lao Yang...
Yang Wei finally saw that it was an extremely small ghost. It did not flow with other ghosts but stopped and waited for him.
From the appearance, it looks like a broken rag with a string connected to it like a kite, connected to another little ghost.
"Lao Yang, Lao Yang, I'm here...
The ghost was still shouting, Yang Wei knelt down and carefully held it in his hand
